items.q: How long do the batteries last?
items.a: With 3 standard alkaline AA batteries, the ultra-low power motor operates continuously for 4 to 6 months depending on temperature.

items.q: What happens if a chicken stops in the doorway while closing?
items.a: The door features an intelligent anti-pinch safety sensor. If it contacts an obstruction, the descent immediately pauses, reverses, and re-attempts closing 20 seconds later.

items.q: Will raccoons or foxes be able to pry the door open?
items.a: No. The door is securely locked by an internal mechanical worm gear when fully closed. Predators cannot slide or pry it upward from the outside.

items.q: Is the suction base strong enough for hard blocks of parmesan?
items.a: Yes! The heavy-duty silicone vacuum base generates strong grip when locked to any non-porous countertop including granite, quartz, tile, glass, and smooth laminates.

items.q: Can I wash this in the dishwasher?
items.a: All detachable parts—the clear food barrel, 5 stainless steel drums, handle, and food pusher—are 100% top-rack dishwasher safe. Rinse the suction base under the tap.

items.q: Is it suitable for nuts and hard chocolate?
items.a: Absolutely. The fine grinding drum effortlessly powders walnuts, pecans, almonds, peanuts, and chocolate blocks for dessert toppings.
